body.intent: Fix A run whose change bumps the log entry format can never pass review/code. Run 01M72YSG33J9JB66SYG9AD0Z0F (Docs sign-off workflow, change set 01M71G46Q5378CYYVEHFF2EMP3) failed at review/code with three causes like: 'rhiza check: fail log .rhiza/log/01M71G4BKFHP1E172RR6H82WFT/01M731FHDC43E8XR3XAPNAFE1Y.json: entry: newer format: field "v": 5, this Rhiza reads 4'. The builder's own binary wrote v5 entries (pinning a change set's workflow), but run code-check runs rhiza check in-process with the installed daemon binary (internal/api/run_codecheck.go runCheck; entry.ErrNewerFormat at internal/entry/entry.go:43), which reads only v4. #417 (01M6ZT7P) skipped the reference rules for the same root cause but not this one. Expected: code-check checks a run's worktree with that worktree's own build (or otherwise accepts the format its change introduces), so format bumps can ship through the daemon. Unstick: once fixed and merged (daemon self-updates), rhiza run resume --retry 01M72YSG33J9JB66SYG9AD0Z0F.
